lines.speaker: frontier-mother
lines.text: Mr. Kirk, Dexter is in school.

lines.speaker: frontier-headmaster
lines.text: I'm afraid he's not, Mrs. Fishpaw.

lines.speaker: frontier-headmaster
lines.text: Dexter's truancy problem is way out of hand.

lines.speaker: frontier-headmaster
lines.text: The Baltimore County School Board have decided to expel Dexter from the entire public school system.

lines.speaker: frontier-mother
lines.text: Oh, Mr. Kirk, I am as upset as you to learn of Dexter's truancy,

lines.speaker: frontier-mother
lines.text: but surely expulsion is not the answer?

lines.speaker: frontier-headmaster
lines.text: I'm afraid expulsion is the only answer.

lines.speaker: frontier-headmaster
lines.text: It's the opinion of the entire staff that Dexter is criminally insane.

lines.speaker: frontier-parrot
lines.text: You're lying down on the couch?

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: He was white as a sheet.

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: And he also made false teeth.

lines.speaker: frontier-cowboy
lines.text: Did I ever tell you the story about cowboys?

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: A man with a golden eyeball.

lines.speaker: frontier-parrot
lines.text: You're lying down on the couch?

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: He was white as a sheet.

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: And he also made false teeth.

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: Can you think of anything that talks, other than a person?

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: Yeah, some birds are funny when they talk.

lines.speaker: frontier-announcer
lines.text: Can you think of anything else?
